title: docs-deploy params
description: Operator-facing config keys for the docs-deploy bundle — ADR-0081's locked decision: bundle params validate against JSON Schema. token_env/secret_env are secret NAMES, never values. All VCS/forge ops go through lasius (`lasius vcs`/`lasius forge`).

worktree_base.description: Base dir for the deploy worktrees — each run gets <worktree_base>/docs-<repo>-<sha>[ /docs ].

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (`lasius --root`) — repo args are clone names resolved under <lasius_root>/<repos_dir>/<name>. Ships the org-workspace path (same as pr-heal); review per deployment.

token_env.description: NAME of the secret holding the forge token. Injected into node env as BUPHA_TOKEN (gh-pages push credential.helper) and GH_TOKEN (`gh api` inside `lasius forge status create` / `lasius add`). Never the value; the shipped env blocks name BUPHA_TOKEN literally.

timeout.description: Inner deploy-command cap in seconds (the deploy node's own shell timeout is 900 to cover lasius setup + cleanup).

context.description: GitHub commit-status context posted on the pushed docs-branch sha (via `lasius forge status create`).

main_ref.description: Rev the gen-dependent repos' second worktree checks out at the run root (<run>), so docs:deploy's `cd ..` gen steps (cargo run/doc) see the main checkout. Remote-tracking (`origin/main`) so it reflects the last `lasius vcs fetch` — a local refs/heads/main can lag. Ignored by the self-contained repos.

cmd.description: Deploy command run at the worktree root (= the docs branch root). Default: bun install (frozen-lockfile, plain fallback) + env-scoped git credential.helper/author + `bun run docs:deploy`. Override per-install; keep the credential.helper export or gh-pages pushes will be anonymous.
